source: ./run.sh (usage header + the ${VAR:-default} block) and server/app.py::build_settings on the installed build at ~/recipes/qwen-image-21-spark, VERSION 0.1.1, cross-checked against the live /readyz
notes: Every setting is an environment variable read once at startup, so the configuration is the environment: the registry name is the QIMG_ variable lower-cased and hyphenated (max-pixels = QIMG_MAX_PIXELS). The defaults below are the ones this build actually ships, read from run.sh and from the fallbacks in server/app.py rather than from the README table. Two of them moved in 0.1.1 and are the reason this file cannot be shared with 0.1.0: max-pixels 4227072 -> 4300800 and stop-grace 180 -> 420. guidance-scale is not an environment variable at all — it is a per-request field defaulting to 1.0 in build_job, which is the value every measurement here ran at. The checkout is not a git working tree (it was unpacked, not cloned), so there is no commit to name beyond the VERSION file and the diffusers sha the server reports.

params.name: model
params.help: QIMG_MODEL_REPO — the Hugging Face repo ./run.sh download fetches. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: model-dir
params.help: QIMG_MODEL_DIR — where the checkpoint lives. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: device
params.help: QIMG_DEVICE. auto is resolved once at load: cuda if a CUDA device exists, else mps on Apple silicon, else cpu. /readyz reports which one was taken.

params.name: dtype
params.help: QIMG_DTYPE — the dtype the whole pipeline is loaded in. This lane exists to be bf16.

params.name: attention
params.help: QIMG_ATTENTION — the attention backend handed to the pipeline. /readyz echoes it.

params.name: default-steps
params.help: QIMG_DEFAULT_STEPS — denoising steps when a request sends neither num_inference_steps nor steps. Every image workload sends its own, so this does not move a number here.

params.name: default-size
params.help: QIMG_DEFAULT_SIZE — the size a request without size/width/height gets. Accepts WxH, a native 2K ratio name, name@1K, 1K or 2K.

params.name: max-pixels
params.help: QIMG_MAX_PIXELS — the largest batch, in pixels, the server will accept (n * width * height). 4300800 is the largest native size by area, 2400x1792. A request above it is refused with a 400, never shrunk.

params.name: max-queue
params.help: QIMG_MAX_QUEUE — how many requests may wait for the single GPU lock before the server answers 503. Irrelevant at concurrency 1.

params.name: timeout
params.help: QIMG_TIMEOUT — seconds a single job may hold the GPU before it is abandoned.

params.name: stop-grace
params.help: QIMG_STOP_GRACE — how long ./run.sh stop waits for the in-flight image before SIGKILL; uvicorn's --timeout-graceful-shutdown is set ten seconds inside it. Shutdown only, so it cannot move a measured number.

params.name: output-dir
params.help: QIMG_OUTPUT_DIR — where rendered files are kept for /outputs and response_format=url. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: api-key
params.help: QIMG_API_KEY — bearer token required on every route when set. Dropped from the fingerprint.

params.name: guidance-scale
params.help: Per-request, not an environment variable: build_job reads guidance_scale or true_cfg_scale and falls back to 1.0. Above 1.0 the pipeline runs a second transformer forward per step, so it roughly doubles seconds per image. Recorded here because a lane's effective guidance is what makes two lanes comparable.

params.name: output-format
params.help: Per-request. Forced to png whenever transparent is true, because only png carries the alpha channel here.

params.name: transparent
params.help: Per-request. Switches the pipeline to the RGBA mode and rewrites the prompt through rgba_prompt(); `background: transparent` is accepted as OpenAI's spelling of the same thing.
